messages.text:
BL-780 — note_actionable_after_ms (20m) is longer than flow_watchdog_warn_ms (15m): an aged note ALWAYS alarms the human before the swarm is allowed to rotate for it
What it solves: Orthogonal to BL-651 in behaviour but adjacent in files
(`mono_router_lib.bb`), so do not run the two concurrently — sequence this
after BL-651 lands.
Approval context: A one-line default change with a real trade-off only the human should make, surfaced by the specifier on 2026-08-01 while speccing BL-651 (whose Shape requires the rotation threshold to sit "comfortably BELOW the watchdog's WARN threshold"). BL-651 meets that for git_handoffs; notes cannot, because…
BL-780 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-780" (or "reject BL-780 <reason>") to act.
